info.name: SkatePod API (local)
info.description:
Requests and checks for the SkatePod backend running on your Mac (http://localhost:8080/api).

Before you start: run the backend from backend/ with ./mvnw spring-boot:run. Use the Postman desktop app (or the Desktop Agent) so Postman can reach localhost.

Run the whole collection in order with Run collection. It creates a test student (Mai) and gives her lessons, a note, a program and an availability block, tries the error cases, then deletes everything it made. The sample students are only read, never changed.

This collection is also saved in the repo at backend/postman/SkatePod-API.postman_collection.json. If data gets messy: stop the backend, run dropdb --force skatepod && createdb -O skatepod skatepod, and start it again.

exec: // Dates the requests need, worked out fresh each time (local time, like the backend's clock).
const shift = days => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + days); return d; };

item.name: 1. Students: read
item.description: Reads the sample students. Nothing is changed.

exec: pm.test("Has the 6 sample students (or more)", () => { pm.expect(body.length).to.be.at.least(6); });
pm.test("Sorted A to Z by name", () => { const n = body.map(s => s.name); pm.expect(n).to.eql([...n].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))); });
pm.test("No focus or progress anymore", () => { body.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s).to.not.have.property('focus'); pm.expect(s).to.not.have.property('progress'); }); });
pm.test("Every discipline has a track", () => { body.forEach(s => s.disciplines.forEach(d => pm.expect(['CHAMPIONSHIP', 'EXCEL', 'ADULT']).to.include(d.track))); });

item.name: Get Emma (next lesson from the weekly calendar)

exec: pm.test("Name is Emma Miller", () => { pm.expect(body.name).to.eql('Emma Miller'); });
pm.test("Freeskate comes before Skills (catalog order)", () => { pm.expect(body.disciplines.map(d => d.discipline)).to.eql(['STANDARD_FREESKATE', 'STANDARD_SKILLS']); });

pm.test("Has a next lesson within the next 7 days", () => { pm.expect(body.nextLesson).to.be.an('object'); const days = (new Date(body.nextLesson.date) - new Date(pm.collectionVariables.get('today'))) / 86400000; pm.expect(days).to.be.within(0, 7); });

item.name: Get Noah (his lessons ended: not scheduled)

exec: pm.test("Learn to Skate is first, starting at Snowplow Sam 1", () => { pm.expect(body[0].discipline).to.eql('LEARN_TO_SKATE'); pm.expect(body[0].levels[0]).to.eql('Snowplow Sam 1'); });

item.name: 2. Students: create and update
item.description: Creates a test student, Mai. Everything Mai gets is deleted again in the last folder.

exec: pm.test("Disciplines come back in catalog order", () => { pm.expect(body.disciplines.map(d => d.discipline)).to.eql(['ADULT_FREESKATE', 'PATTERN_DANCE']); });
pm.test("No lessons yet, so no next lesson", () => { pm.expect(body.nextLesson).to.be.null; });

item.name: Update Mai to the Excel track

exec: pm.test("The new list replaced the old one", () => { pm.expect(body.disciplines).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(body.disciplines[0].discipline).to.eql('STANDARD_FREESKATE'); });
pm.test("Leaving the phone out clears it", () => { pm.expect(body.phone).to.be.null; });

item.name: 3. Students: errors on purpose
item.description: Requests that should fail, to check the error handling.

exec: pm.test("Says what is wrong", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql('Juvenile is not a level in Standard Track (Freeskate)'); });
pm.test("Says what is wrong", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql('Standard Track (Freeskate) is listed more than once'); });

item.name: 4. Lessons (weekly)
item.description: Lessons repeat every week on their day and time, from startDate to an optional endDate, like the app's calendar. Mai's test lessons go on Sunday evening, where the sample data has nothing.

exec: pm.test("In week order (Monday first, then by time)", () => { const k = body.map(l => DAYS.indexOf(l.dayOfWeek) * 10000 + Number(l.startTime.replace(/:/g, '').slice(0, 4))); pm.expect(k).to.eql([...k].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });
pm.test("Only the 3 lesson types", () => { body.forEach(l => pm.expect(['Public', 'Freestyle', 'Off-ice']).to.include(l.type)); });
pm.test("Color follows the type", () => { const c = { Freestyle: 'TEAL', Public: 'SAND', 'Off-ice': 'PURPLE' }; body.forEach(l => pm.expect(l.color).to.eql(c[l.type])); });
pm.test("Emma's Thursday 7:00 lesson is at North Rink", () => { const l = body.find(x => x.studentName === 'Emma Miller' && x.dayOfWeek === 'THURSDAY'); pm.expect(l.place).to.eql('North Rink'); });
pm.test("Only Emma's lessons", () => { pm.response.json().forEach(l => pm.expect(l.studentName).to.eql('Emma Miller')); });
pm.test("Starts today when no start date is sent", () => { pm.expect(body.startDate).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('today')); });
pm.test("Weekly, no end date, teal", () => { pm.expect(body.dayOfWeek).to.eql('SUNDAY'); pm.expect(body.endDate).to.be.null; pm.expect(body.color).to.eql('TEAL'); });

item.name: Mai now has a next lesson

exec: pm.test("Next lesson is a Sunday at 20:00", () => { pm.expect(new Date(body.nextLesson.date + 'T12:00:00').getDay()).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.nextLesson.startTime).to.eql('20:00:00'); });
pm.test("Status is 409 (8:30 PM is during Mai's lesson)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test("Status is 201 (starts right when Mai's lesson ends)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

item.name: Same time, but only after Mai's lesson ends → 201

exec: pm.test("Status is 201 (the dates never meet)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test("Status is 400 (only Public, Freestyle or Off-ice)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

item.name: 5. Availability blocks
item.description: Optional "I can coach here" times. Lessons that start inside one show its place.

exec: pm.test("Monday first, then by time", () => { const k = body.map(b => DAYS.indexOf(b.dayOfWeek) * 10000 + Number(b.startTime.replace(/:/g, '').slice(0, 4))); pm.expect(k).to.eql([...k].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });

item.name: Add Sunday 7-10 PM at Test Rink
Mai's Sunday lesson is now at Test Rink
6. Notes (training history)
item.description: The Lessons tab. Listing notes first adds an empty entry for every calendar lesson that has started since the last check.

exec: pm.test("Newest first", () => { const t = body.map(n => n.date); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort().reverse()); });
pm.test("Has the 4 sample notes (or more)", () => { pm.expect(body.length).to.be.at.least(4); });

item.name: 7. Programs
item.description: A student can have several programs, each with a name. The music can be a link and/or a file uploaded with POST /api/music (not in this collection: it needs a file on your Mac, see requests.http).

exec: pm.test("Both of Lily's programs, oldest first", () => pm.expect(names).to.eql(['Free skate 2026-27', 'Spring showcase']));
pm.test("Elements kept in order", () => pm.expect(body.elements.map(e => e.code)).to.eql(['2S', '1A', 'CSp', '2A+1Eu+3S']));
pm.test("A jump combination is one element", () => pm.expect(body.elements[3].title).to.eql('3 Jump Combination'));

pm.test("Name, link and rink map kept", () => { pm.expect(body.name).to.eql('Free skate'); pm.expect(body.musicLink).to.eql('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=example'); pm.expect(body.paths).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(body.placements[0].code).to.eql('2S'); pm.expect(body.musicFile).to.be.null; });
pm.test("Two programs", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.name)).to.eql(['Free skate', 'Spring showcase']));
pm.test("Renamed, link removed", () => { pm.expect(body.name).to.eql('Free skate 2026-27'); pm.expect(body.musicLink).to.be.null; });

item.name: Move the program to another student → 400

exec: pm.test("Says why", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql('Juvenile is not a level in the Excel track'));

item.name: Music link that isn't a web link → 400

exec: pm.test("47 elements, starting with 1T", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.length(47); pm.expect(b[0].code).to.eql('1T'); });

item.name: 8. Clean up
item.description: Deletes Mai, and checks that her lessons and programs went with her.

exec: pm.test("Status is 404 (deleting a student deletes their lessons)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
